title: SCA Minhag of the Week 230: "Serving Fish on Shabbat"

chapters.title: Customs and sources for eating fish
chapters.about: Tikune Shabbat, Arizal, Rabbi Haim Vital, Gemara

chapters.title: Rambam and Maran on Shabbat fish
chapters.about: Mishneh Torah, Shulchan Aruch, Halachic obligation

chapters.title: Adages and community practices
chapters.about: Rabbi Yaaqob Raccah, Ben Ish Hai, Halab delicacies

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the various customs regarding the consumption of fish during Shabbat meals. He explores the perspectives of the Mekubalim, the Gemara, and the rulings of Rambam and Maran, while also noting specific community practices in Halab and Brooklyn.
questions: Is there a requirement to eat fish on Shabbat?
What does the Gemara say about eating fish for Shabbat?
Why did some communities not serve fish on Shabbat?
What is the significance of the word Dag in relation to Shabbat?
